title: MessageChangeBatch v1
description: What changed in one inbox, in order: upserts and removals of messages in provider-neutral form. Produced by the connectors module, stored as a blob (content type `application/vnd.campbooks.message-changes+json; version=1`) in the workspace, and applied by the job `conversations.apply_changes`. Applying is idempotent per (inbox, provider_message_id). Bodies and attachments are blobs the producer stores before the batch.

inbox.description: The conversations inbox the batch is for.

backfill.description: Read by the stream's first sync (its backfill): mail the inbox held before it was connected. The streams of its messages are never mirrored to the provider. Absent means false.

blobRef.description: A blob stored in the workspace (campbooks_kernel::blobs::BlobRef).

oneOf.description: The message exists at the provider in this state: insert it, or update its flags, mailbox state and labels.
The message is gone from the provider.

provider_message_id.description: Unique and stable within the inbox.

thread_key.description: The provider's thread id (Gmail threadId, Graph conversationId); messages sharing it form one conversation.

references.description: RFC 5322 References, oldest first, without angle brackets.

direction.description: Received by the inbox, or sent from it.

headers.description: The headers subset sorting reads, values as sent, unfolded.

authentication_results.description: The receiving provider's own Authentication-Results (RFC 8601), unfolded: the topmost one, only when its authserv-id is the provider's. A connector that cannot tell leaves it out.

content_id.description: The part's Content-ID without angle brackets: what the HTML part's cid: images name. At most 255 characters; a longer one is left out.

labels.description: The provider's user labels (Gmail labels, Graph categories, IMAP keywords).

categories.description: The provider's own sorting (Gmail's category tabs), normalised.

provider_stream.description: The stream a received message is in at the provider: its stream mark (a provider label named Campbooks/<Stream>), else its native place. null when it is in none of the four (Gmail's Social and Forums tabs, marks of several streams). Absent when the adapter cannot tell (sent mail, a grant without labels): the stored value is then left as it is.

stream_mark_stale.description: The message's category changed at the provider while it kept a stream mark: provider_stream is the category's, and the mark is to be taken off. Absent means false.
